interfaces.name: Graphical application client
interfaces.technology: Web app, iOS/iPadOS and Android mobile apps, macOS desktop app, Chrome browser extension
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed by manipulating presented affordances (agendas, notes, calendar views, controls) of a persistent, navigable representation of the account's service state. All client surfaces share the same primitive, base state, and authentication, so they form one logical interface materialized across technologies.

provenance.evidence: Provider (SoapBox Innovations) app-store listing describing the iOS/iPad app and the 'Hypercontext Mac App' with navigable menu-bar calendar, agendas, notes and next steps: affordance-manipulation UI. Freshness: Hypercontext-era clients; provider now Spinach AI.
Provider web login ('Hypercontext is now Spinach AI', Continue with Google/Email/Microsoft) confirms the web application client.

interfaces.name: Account HTTP API
interfaces.technology: HTTP endpoint authenticated with a private per-account API key
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations (create/close next steps) through structured HTTP requests authenticated by a per-account API key. Operation invocation via structured requests fixes the paradigm as Programmatic; the consumer type (Zapier) does not determine the channel.

provenance.evidence: Provider help center documents generating a private account API key and a structured request body format (next_step_id: ##) to invoke next-step operations from another application. Scope/freshness: no standalone public API reference located; documentation confined to the Zapier integration context.

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: No official evidence of a native event/webhook interface with a consumer-controlled receiver; event-like delivery is mediated by the third-party Zapier integration
No official evidence of a natural-language interface within the Hypercontext product contract; voice commands are documented under Spinach's meeting assistant, out of Hypercontext scope
Automated note emails are an outbound notification feature, not a consumer-invocable interface

access_mechanism_ledger.mechanism: Third-party integrations (Slack, Teams, Google Calendar/Meet, Outlook, Zoom, Jira, Asana, Linear, Airtable, Zapier 3000+ apps)
access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Third-party integrations, not provider-defined logical interfaces
